text:
As I move about the house

saying darling to you

with a fervent voice

with desperation

that this poor word

may not be enough to caress you

or sacrifice something

or give my life for you

darling

to summon you

to do something for this

for this invalid love.

And that is all,

darling.

I say darling and see

your eyes still pressed to mine

as if bound by love

looking at me, looking at me

while we made love

your eyes looking at me

your whole face

you

and it was life or death

to be like that

looking at each other.

And I close the windows saying

darling

darling, and I don’t care

that you are thinking of something else

and no longer even remember.

I am stopped

in that gaze of yours

in that look of yours

in our love, looking at each other

and I wander through the house

turning off the lights

putting away the dresses

thinking of you

looking at you

not letting you fall

yearning for you

loving you

saying darling.
